title: Add admin controls, music system, local storage caching, and top-down shooter game

requirements.summary: Add delete buttons for individual comments in Admin Panel with confirmation dialogs
acceptanceCriteria: Each comment in the admin panel displays a delete button
Clicking delete removes the comment from backend storage
UI updates immediately after deletion without page refresh
Deletion requires confirmation to prevent accidental removal

file_operations.description: Add delete button UI for each comment row in the comment list management section with confirmation dialog. Wire to the removeComment backend method using the useQueries hook. Update UI state immediately after successful deletion.

requirements.summary: Add delete buttons for individual usernames in Admin Live List Panel with confirmation dialogs
acceptanceCriteria: Each username in live lists displays a delete button
Clicking delete removes only that username from the selected app/event
UI reflects the deletion immediately
Deletion includes confirmation dialog

file_operations.description: Add delete button UI for each username entry in the live list. Wire to the removeUsernameFromAppEvent backend method using useAdminLiveListQueries hook. Include confirmation dialog before deletion and update UI immediately after successful removal.

requirements.summary: Add Clear All button to Admin Panel that removes all data with double confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Clear All button visible in admin panel main view
Button requires double confirmation before executing
Clears all comments from all lists
Clears all app/event entries and their usernames
Shows success message after clearing
Updates all dependent UI elements immediately

file_operations.description: Add a prominent Clear All button in the admin panel header or toolbar. Wire to the clearEverything backend method using the useQueries hook. Implement double confirmation dialog (two-step confirmation) before executing. Show success toast notification after clearing and invalidate all relevant queries to refresh the UI.

requirements.summary: Implement one-click download feature in Admin Panel exporting all data in CSV and JSON formats
acceptanceCriteria: Download button prominently placed in admin panel
Single click triggers download of multiple files or a zip archive
Exports comments list as CSV and JSON
Exports app/event data with usernames as CSV and JSON
Files are named descriptively with timestamps
Download works across modern browsers

file_operations.description: Create utility functions to fetch all data from backend (comments via getCommentList for all list IDs, app events via getAllAppEvents), convert to CSV and JSON formats, and trigger browser downloads with timestamped filenames. Support both individual file downloads and optional zip archive bundling.

Add a Download All Data button in the admin panel toolbar. Wire to the dataExport utility to fetch all comments and app/event data, then trigger downloads of CSV and JSON files with descriptive timestamps. Show loading state during data fetch and export process.

requirements.summary: Implement local storage caching for comment lists, app events, and usernames with background sync
acceptanceCriteria: All list data is cached in localStorage on fetch
Cached data loads instantly on page load
Background sync with backend occurs after displaying cache
Cache updates when backend data changes
Cache invalidation strategy prevents stale data
Performance improvement is measurable (faster initial render)

file_operations.description: Create a local storage cache manager with methods to get, set, and invalidate cached data for comment lists, app events, and usernames. Include timestamp-based cache invalidation strategy (e.g., 5-minute TTL) and versioning to handle schema changes.

Modify React Query hooks to check localStorage cache first before fetching from backend. Return cached data immediately for instant display, then fetch from backend in the background and update cache. Wire cache invalidation to mutation success callbacks.

Modify admin live list queries to use localStorage cache for app events and usernames. Return cached data first for instant render, then background sync with backend. Update cache on all mutation successes.

requirements.summary: Add background music system with auto-play, play/pause, and volume controls
acceptanceCriteria: Music attempts to auto-play on site load (muted if browser blocks unmuted autoplay)
Play/pause button visible in UI (header or fixed position)
Volume slider control accessible to users
Music state persists across page navigation
Graceful fallback if autoplay is blocked
User preferences (volume level, play state) saved in localStorage

file_operations.description: Create a React hook that manages background music playback using the HTML5 Audio API. Implement auto-play with muted fallback for browser autoplay policies, play/pause toggle, volume control, and persistence of user preferences (volume level, play state) in localStorage. Handle music URL fetching from backend and state management across component lifecycle.

Create a fixed-position UI component (likely in header or bottom-right corner) displaying play/pause button and volume slider. Use the useMusicPlayer hook to wire controls. Style with icons and smooth transitions matching the app design.

Integrate the MusicControls component into the header layout. Position it accessibly for all users while maintaining the existing header structure (branding, theme toggle, admin unlock status, logout button).
Initialize the useMusicPlayer hook at the App level to ensure music state persists across tab navigation and page changes. Handle auto-play attempt on app mount with graceful fallback if blocked.

requirements.summary: Add music upload and management functionality to Admin Panel with preview, replace, and remove options
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes music management section
File upload accepts MP3 and WAV formats
Uploaded music is stored in backend as a blob or asset
All users receive the same music URL from backend
Admin can preview uploaded music before making it live
Admin can replace or remove current music
Music changes propagate to all connected users within reasonable time

file_operations.description: Create admin component for music file management. Include file input accepting MP3 and WAV formats, upload progress tracking using ExternalBlob.withUploadProgress, preview player for uploaded music, and buttons to make music live, replace, or remove. Wire to backend methods for storing and retrieving music blob references. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a new Music Management tab in the admin panel containing the AdminMusicManager component. Position it alongside existing tabs (Comment Lists, Chat, User Images, Bulk Generator Keys, Live Lists).

Update the music player hook to fetch the current music URL from backend on initialization. Poll or refetch periodically to detect music changes uploaded by admin. Update the audio source dynamically when a new music file is detected.

requirements.summary: Replace Interactive3DCube with a lightweight top-down shooter 2D game using HTML5 Canvas
acceptanceCriteria: Game renders in the same position where the 3D cube currently displays
Player character can move in four directions using keyboard controls
Player can shoot projectiles toward mouse cursor or in a fixed direction
Enemies spawn periodically and move toward player
Collision detection between projectiles and enemies
Score counter displays enemy defeats
Game over condition when player is hit by enemies
Restart button available after game over
Game runs smoothly at 60 FPS on modern devices
Visual style matches or complements the existing app design

file_operations.description: Create a 2D game component using HTML5 Canvas rendering a top-down shooter. Implement player movement (WASD or arrow keys), shooting mechanics (mouse click or spacebar), enemy wave spawning with AI that moves toward player, collision detection (projectiles vs enemies, enemies vs player), score tracking, game over state, and restart functionality. Use requestAnimationFrame for 60 FPS rendering. Keep visual style simple with shapes/sprites that complement the app design. Store game state (score, high score) in component state.
Replace the Interactive3DCube component import and usage with the new TopDownShooterGame component. Maintain the same layout position and container styling to preserve the overall page structure.

requirements.summary: Maintain secure data handling for all new features with admin access code protection
acceptanceCriteria: Admin access code validation required for delete operations
Admin access code validation required for Clear All operation
Admin access code validation required for music management
File uploads validated for type and size
No sensitive data exposed in frontend code
Backend validates all admin operations with access code

file_operations.description: Ensure all new admin operations (delete comments, Clear All button) pass the admin access code from adminPinSession.ts to backend methods. Validate user confirmation before executing destructive operations.
Ensure delete username operations pass the admin access code to the backend removeUsernameFromAppEvent method for validation.
Add client-side file type validation (MP3, WAV only) and file size limits (e.g., 10MB max) before upload. Pass admin access code to any backend music management methods to ensure authorization.
Ensure data export fetches use admin-protected backend methods with the access code from adminPinSession.ts. Do not expose sensitive data structures or access tokens in exported files.
